courses.title: Generative AI Engineering: Enterprise Integration Crash Course
courses.description: Accelerate your development lifecycle by mastering Generative AI architectures, prompt orchestration, and LLM integration. Designed for enterprise software engineers, this crash course covers production RAG implementation, tool calling, and evaluation frameworks. Learn to build secure, scalable AI capabilities directly into your existing enterprise software stack.

courses.title: Ethical AI Engineering: Principles, Practices, and Responsible Development
courses.description: Learn to design, build, and deploy enterprise AI systems responsibly without compromising performance. This course introduces core ethical frameworks, algorithmic bias detection, data privacy standards, and practical governance patterns for everyday engineering workflows. By the end, you will possess actionable techniques to audit systems and advocate for responsible AI across the SDLC.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations of Ethical AI and Engineering Responsibilities
Module 2: Identifying and Mitigating Algorithmic Bias in Data and Models
Module 3: Data Privacy, Security, and Compliance in Enterprise AI Pipelines
Module 4: Model Explainability, Transparency, and Auditability in Production
Module 5: Operationalizing Responsible AI: Governance, Testing, and Monitoring
